item.title: Version 8.2.1
item.description:
• Presentify is now available in Simplified Chinese, Japanese, Korean, and Brazilian Portuguese.
• Smoother freehand drawing: fast curves no longer show sharp corners.
• New "Clear All" option in each section of the Shortcuts settings.
• Presentify now warns you when an annotation shortcut conflicts with another shortcut, including ⌘Z and ⇧⌘Z.
• Fixed redo after moving annotations.
• Clicking a selected annotation no longer adds an empty undo step.
• Your chosen screenshot folder is now remembered more reliably.
• Clearer menu labels, such as "Turn Off Zoom".
• Shortcut fields in the Shortcuts settings are now properly centered on macOS 27.
• Minor improvements around license management.
